about: Quality gate of jarvis/domain/tool_relevance.py (plugins MCP, Slice 04; docs/mcp/plugins.md §6.4). Corpus = native catalog of the servers below + fake Circuit-like mail/calendar/contacts tools (test data only, never product code). Each intent passes when one of `expected` is in the top 3.

external_tools.name: search_emails
external_tools.title: Search emails
external_tools.description: Search the user's mailbox. Returns matching messages (id, sender, subject, date, snippet).

query.description: Free text: sender, subject or words of the message

external_tools.name: get_email
external_tools.title: Read an email
external_tools.description: Read one email by id: headers, full body and attachment names.

external_tools.name: send_email
external_tools.title: Send an email
external_tools.description: Send an email now from the user's account.

external_tools.name: create_draft
external_tools.title: Create a draft
external_tools.description: Create an email draft (not sent) that the user can review later.

external_tools.name: list_mail_folders
external_tools.title: List mail folders
external_tools.description: List the mailbox folders and their unread counts.

external_tools.name: list_events
external_tools.title: List calendar events
external_tools.description: List calendar events between two dates (meetings, appointments).

external_tools.name: create_event
external_tools.title: Create a calendar event
external_tools.description: Create or schedule a calendar event, optionally inviting attendees.

external_tools.name: update_event
external_tools.title: Update a calendar event
external_tools.description: Update an existing calendar event: time, title or attendees.

external_tools.name: delete_event
external_tools.title: Delete a calendar event
external_tools.description: Delete a calendar event and notify its attendees.

external_tools.name: find_free_slots
external_tools.title: Find free time slots
external_tools.description: Find free time slots in the calendar for a meeting of a given duration.

external_tools.name: search_contacts
external_tools.title: Search contacts
external_tools.description: Search the user's contacts by name, company or email address. Returns id, name, email, phone.

external_tools.name: get_contact
external_tools.title: Read a contact
external_tools.description: Read one contact by id: emails, phone numbers, company, notes.

external_tools.name: create_contact
external_tools.title: Create a contact
external_tools.description: Add a new contact to the address book.
